SETTINGS.DESC: These bindings tell the audience engine where to read each rule. Changing them changes who a disparo targets. Unset values fall back to the platform defaults shown below.

OPT_OUT.TITLE: Opt-out
OPT_OUT.NOTE: How a contact signals they don't want to be contacted.

LABEL.LABEL: Permanent opt-out label
LABEL.HINT: Contacts with this label are always excluded. Compared case-insensitively.

STEPS.LABEL: Opt-out kanban stages
STEPS.PLACEHOLDER: Type a stage value and press enter
STEPS.HINT: Contacts in any of these kanban stages are excluded. Values are compared as text.

KEYS.TITLE: Custom-attribute keys
KEYS.NOTE: The conversation custom-attribute keys the engine reads to apply each rule. Match the keys your automations write.

OPT_OUT_LGPD.LABEL: LGPD opt-out key
OPT_OUT_LGPD.HINT: Truthy on a conversation means the contact opted out (LGPD).

FOLLOWUP_LOCKED.LABEL: Follow-up locked key
FOLLOWUP_LOCKED.HINT: Truthy means follow-up is locked and the contact is skipped.

WINDOW_CLOSES_AT.LABEL: Window closes-at key
WINDOW_CLOSES_AT.HINT: Timestamp of when the messaging window closes.

KANBAN_STEP.LABEL: Kanban stage key
KANBAN_STEP.HINT: Holds the contact's current kanban stage, matched against the opt-out stages above.

WHATSAPP_INVALID_AT.LABEL: WhatsApp invalid-at key
WHATSAPP_INVALID_AT.HINT: Timestamp of when WhatsApp last flagged the number as invalid.

WINDOWS.TITLE: Windows
WINDOWS.NOTE: Rolling time windows, in days, that exclude recently-contacted or recently-flagged numbers.

DEDUP.LABEL: Dedup window (days)
DEDUP.HINT: Skip a contact that already received the same template within this many days.

WHATSAPP_INVALID.LABEL: WhatsApp invalid window (days)
WHATSAPP_INVALID.HINT: Skip a number flagged invalid by WhatsApp within this many days.

VALIDATION.POSITIVE_INTEGER: Enter a whole number of days greater than zero.
VALIDATION.STEPS_REQUIRED: Add at least one opt-out kanban stage.
